title: Naturality of single-source internal Hom complexes
statement: For a scheme Y, O_Y-module sheaves P,Q and a morphism k:Q → P, the single-source comparison [lem-sc-hom-complex-single] can be chosen as natural isomorphisms b_P:Hom(P[0],−) ≅ Hom(P,−) applied degreewise and b_Q:Hom(Q[0],−) ≅ Hom(Q,−) applied degreewise. Under these isomorphisms precomposition by k[0] agrees with degreewise precomposition by k. The Hom complexes are those of [def-pur-hom-complex].

source.place: Section 0A8X, Hom-complex product and functoriality formulas

proof.text:
For each sheaf P and complex I, project the product defining Hom(P[0],I)
to its degree-zero source factor. All other factors are zero, because P[0]^p
is zero for p different from zero. The inverse is the product lift with this
component and zero elsewhere. The product universal property gives both inverse
identities. The differential formula reduces to postcomposition by d_I, as the
source differential vanishes. Naturality in I follows from the postcomposition
formula for the product projections. For k:Q → P, the precomposition formula for
those same projections identifies Hom(k[0],I) with degreewise internal Hom(k,I).
These arguments apply to unbounded I, zero P or Q, and the empty scheme.

proof_origin.place: Section 0A8X, Hom-complex product and functoriality formulas
